name: West Virginia Manufacturing Solutions
old_description: "We’ve partnered with WVMS for years, and they’ve consistently delivered high-quality components for our industrial equipment. Their precision machining and attention to detail are second to none. Every project is completed on time and exceeds our expectations."
about:
West Virginia Manufacturing Solutions, Inc. (WVMS) was incorporated in 2004 in Montgomery, West Virginia. The company operates from a facility on Morris Drive and focuses on precision CNC machining and fabrication services for industrial clients.

WVMS provides multi-axis CNC turning, milling, and laser cutting, with turning capacity up to 28 inches in diameter. The shop also offers welding, custom metal forming, bending, and assembly, along with finishing services such as heat treating, powder coating, and deburring. Additional capabilities include prototyping, reverse engineering, and the maintenance and repair of engines, prime movers, and turbochargers.

The company serves a broad range of sectors, including oil and gas, chemical processing, renewable energy, power generation, automotive, aerospace, medical, mining, marine, and hydroelectric industries. Customers include industrial equipment manufacturers, renewable energy project engineers, and automotive procurement specialists, as reflected in testimonials from an operations manager at an industrial solutions firm and a project engineer at a renewable energy group.

WVMS emphasizes a customer-centric approach, stating that quality is a promise rather than a goal. The company highlights its expert engineering team, comprehensive in-house services, and commitment to reliability and on-time delivery as key differentiators.
